items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Sidney Cutlett Roy had gone and you had gone, Sidney Cappa.

ctx.x: Well, it's a football game, you know. And you play this, music is getting into the football idea. Like Mr. Langford give us allowance, years back, you don't have to be saluting, you dig it. And, Minnesota playing Northwestern, you learn the tunes and all that kind of things but those things are events in that part of the country. Glen Miller I think made the Little Brown Jug, you remember? Benx was a good buddy and he always had some things to help me on my writing.
Well, I was thinking that, yeah, you see when I came here first in '37, Smack was at the Savoy then and Sidney Cutlett Roy had gone and you had gone, Sidney Cappa. They had all gone.
Oh, Sid, I shouldn't have past him by. Well, '37 ...
